h: Lagos cancels Saturday sanitation for INEC mock accreditation exercise
p: Lagos Governor Babajide Sanwo-Olu has called off the November environmental sanitation exercise planned for Saturday, 28 November. It clashes with INEC's nationwide mock accreditation and result upload exercise.
body: Lagos State Governor Babajide Sanwo-Olu has cancelled the November edition of the state's monthly environmental sanitation exercise, which was due to hold on Saturday, 28 November 2026.

In a statement on Friday, 27 November, the state government said the exercise clashed with a nationwide mock accreditation and result upload exercise being conducted by the Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC) on the same day.
INEC is testing its accreditation and result upload systems at selected polling units across the country ahead of the January 2027 elections.
more: INEC holds a mock accreditation the same day.
It tests systems ahead of January's polls.
